svg.title: Input-Referred Noise Density and Integrated RMS Noise
svg.text: Noise Performance (.noise V(ADC_IN) V_EAR dec 100 0.5 1k) — R_G = 220 Ω, C_IN = 68 nF
OPA2365 + Passive Network | 5–45 Hz Integrated Noise = 0.14 µVrms | Total Output Noise = 63.3 µVrms (0.31 LSBrms on 14-Bit ADC)
> 40 dB SNR even for 20 µVrms S1/S2
